# @haruhimemoe/invites

> Invites as consent: any ask that leads to notifications is an invite the recipient accepts first. zod schemas for invites and their terms (role, deliverables, deadlines, reminder plan, payment note, proposed time), a pure state machine (pending, countered, accepted, declined, withdrawn, cancelled, expired) with actor checks, resend cooldowns, blocks, rate limits, reminder gating and inbox grouping. zod peer only. ESM for Node 22.12+, Bun, Deno, browsers and bundlers.

Main exports: `createInvite`, `transition`, `allowedActions`, `effectiveState`, `canSend`, `checkBlocks`, `checkCooldown`, `checkRateLimit`, `canRemind`, `inbox`, `InviteSchema`, `InviteDraftSchema`, `InviteTermsSchema`. One entry point: `@haruhimemoe/invites`.

## Docs
